div.head: II As 4
div.ab: [Be hlafordsyrwum.] And we cwædon be hlafordsearwan, þæt he wære his feores scyldig, gyf he hit ætsacan ne mihte oððe on ðam ðryfealdan ordale fúl wære.
Be hlafordsearwum. Ond we cwædon be hlafordsearwe, ðæt he beo his feores scyldig, gif he his ætsacan ne mihte oþþe eft on þam þrimfealdum ordale ful wære.
Be hlafordsearwe. We cwædon be hlafordsearwe, þæt he wære his feores scyldig, gif he his oðsacan ne mehte oððe eft on ðæm þreofealdum ordale ful wære.
De prodicione domini. Diximus de proditoribus dominorum suorum, ut sue ipsius uitę culpabiles habeantur, si non poterit abnegari, uel si in triplici ordalio noxa compareat.
Be hlafordsearwum. Ond we cwædon be hlafordsearwe, ðæt he beo his feores scyldig, gif he his ætsacan ne mihte oþþe eft on þam þrimfealdum ordale ful wære.

And we have declared with regard to one who is accused of plotting against his lord, that he shall forfeit his life if he cannot deny it, or [if he does deny it and] is afterwards found guilty in the threefold ordeal.

Concerning treachery to a lord. And we have pronounced concerning treachery to a lord, that he [who is accused] is to forfeit his life if he cannot deny it or is afterwards convicted at the three-fold ordeal.

Von Verrath (Verräthereien H Ld) am Herrn. Und wir bestimmten über Verrath am Herrn, dass der [Missethäter] sein Leben verwirkt habe, falls er [entweder überhaupt] es nicht leugnen kann oder nachher im dreifachen Ordal überführt wird.

Of treachery (treacheries, H Ld) against a lord. And we determined concerning treachery against a lord that the [offender] shall have forfeited his life if he either cannot deny it [at all] or is afterwards convicted in the threefold ordeal.
div.note: B leaves a space for the rubric; ‘Be hlafordsyrwum’ is supplied from Ld. Liebermann compares Af 4.2.
